q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS total_num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, fr.most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar LEFT JOIN (SELECT f1.bar, f1.drinker AS most_reg_drinker FROM frequents AS f1 JOIN (SELECT bar, MAX(times_a_week) AS max_times_a_week FROM frequents GROUP BY bar) AS f2 ON f1.bar = f2.bar AND f1.times_a_week = f2.max_times_a_week) AS fr ON b.name = fr.bar GROUP BY b.name, fr.most_reg_drinker ORDER BY total_num_drinker DESC, b.name
